title: On-demand pre-entry rule recheck for open positions
description: New GET /positions/{position_id}/compliance-recheck endpoint re-applying SI-01's 5 rule checks against current position state, plus a frontend recheck action reusing PreEntryValidationPanel's visual pattern.
ac_summary: AC-01 endpoint returns pass/fail per rule; AC-02 frontend action renders PreEntryValidationPanel-style states; AC-03 on-demand only, no polling; AC-04 §13 sign-off no new automation surface.

title: Overnight/weekend gap risk flag for open positions
description: Backend gap-risk computation from existing earnings calendar + OHLCV history for open positions; frontend risk flag badge on the Positions page.
ac_summary: AC-01 flag on upcoming earnings date; AC-02 flag on Friday-close weekend hold; AC-03 shows historical average gap magnitude or insufficient-history state; AC-04 §13 sign-off no directional prediction.
